resources.name: Physical constants and adipic acid material properties

access.notes: Constants (molar mass of water 0.018 kg/mol, water density 1000 kg/m^3, surface tension of pure water 0.072 J/m^2, universal gas constant R=8.314 J/mol/K, temperature T=298.15 K, adipic acid solubility 25 g/L, molecular weight 146.14 g/mol, density 1.36 g/cm^3, Szyszkowski–Langmuir parameters a=0.0106, b=11.836) are all publicly known textbook/paper values; no download required.
